End-side Agent Operating System: Aoni AI Agent OS 1.0 Global Launch

excerpt_i18n.zh: 6月10日，火山方舟版权商业化平台正式上线，周星驰旗下比高集团携《喜剧之王》《长江七号》《食神》三大经典影视 IP 率先入驻，双方达成 AI 视频创作版权合作。 火山方舟版权商业化平台依托全球领先的 Seedance 2.0 视频生成模型及完备的版权治理体系，推出业内首个「授权 — 保护 — 审核 — 分发 — 变现」全链路合作机制，为 IP 在 AI 场景下的合规使用与商业价值挖掘提供全新参考模式。 本次合作中，火山引擎与多家工具伙伴共同将周星驰三部经典电影中的代表性桥段制作成创作模板。用户只需上传少量素材，即可一键生成属于自己的经典名场面，轻松产出更具传播力的爆款短视频。 面向企业用户，火山引擎同步开放了一批营销模板，将经过市场验证的爆款内容逻辑沉淀其中。企业可基于授权 IP 和现成模板快速完成创作，将成熟内容形式转化为品牌传播素材。 目前，相关玩法已先行在火山方舟体验中心、火山引擎 Kickart、LibTV、筷子科技丽帧引擎、万兴剧厂、万兴喵影、Pixmax、纳米P视频、快剪辑、360AI智剪、美片等平台上线，用户进入平台、选择模板、上传素材即可完成创作，亲手重现这些经典桥段。抖音也将在后续上线相关玩法。 火山方舟体验中心玩法界面 AI 视频生成降低了内容创作门槛，也让经典 IP 拥有了更多被重新演绎和传播的机会。但授权边界不清、内容审核难、变现不透明，让版权方担心 IP 被滥用或歪曲，优质 IP 因此难以放心流动。 面对这一现状，火山引擎致力于为版权 IP 搭建一套规范
excerpt_i18n.en: On June 10, the Volcano Ark Copyright Commercialization Platform was officially launched. Stephen Chow's Bingo Group, with three classic film IPs—"The King of Comedy," "CJ7," and "The God of Cookery"—became the first to join, establishing an AI video creation copyright partnership. Leveraging the world-leading Seedance 2.0 video generation model and a comprehensive copyright governance system, the platform introduces the industry's first full-chain cooperation mechanism of "authorization—protection—review—distribution—monetization," offering a new reference model for compliant use and commercial value extraction of IPs in AI scenarios. In this collaboration, Volcano Engine and multiple tool partners have created creative templates based on iconic scenes from Stephen Chow's three classic films. Users can generate their own classic moments with just a few materials, easily producing viral short videos with greater reach. For enterprise users, Volcano Engine has also released a set of marketing templates, embedding proven viral content logic. Enterprises can quickly create content based on authorized IPs and ready-made templates, transforming mature content formats into brand promotion materials. Currently, related features are available in the Volcano Ark Experience Center and Volcano Engine.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 10 de junio, la plataforma de comercialización de derechos de autor Volcano Ark se lanzó oficialmente. El grupo Bego, propiedad de Stephen Chow, fue el primero en incorporarse con tres IP cinematográficas clásicas: "El rey de la comedia", "CJ7" y "El chef". Ambas partes alcanzaron un acuerdo de cooperación en derechos de autor para la creación de videos con IA. La plataforma de comercialización de derechos de autor Volcano Ark, basada en el modelo de generación de video Seedance 2.0, líder a nivel mundial, y un sistema completo de gestión de derechos de autor, lanzó el primer flujo de trabajo del sector de "autorización — protección — revisión — distribución".
